newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares firm but off highs, Ericsson gains.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares firm but off highs, Ericsson gains.

text.p: Swedish share prices were off highs by midday Thursday but still in record territory.
Telecoms group Ericsson touched a record at 349 before falling back to trade at 344.5, up four from Wednesday's Stockholm close.
At 1050 GMT the general index was up 0.45 percent at 3,197.97 in light turnover of 1.9 billion crowns.
Market players were sidelined ahead of U.S. June housing starts and jobless claims which were due at 1230 GMT.
"It can't just continue to climb and I think we are now setting a pace," one broker said.

"A lot of this is psychology and many investors are watching to see what the big brokerages like Bergs are doing. Lately they have been net buyers of Ericsson and SKF and both shares are going well today, too," one broker said.
Rollerbearings maker SKF rose three crowns to 219 in the wake of posting a fall in earnings for the first half of the year but optimistic outlook for the rest of the year.
